questions.text: Which organelle is the main site of ATP production?
questions.subject: Biology
questions.explanation: Mitochondria carry out oxidative phosphorylation, which produces most of the cell's ATP.

questions.text: Which of these are found in plant cells but NOT animal cells?
questions.subject: Biology
questions.explanation: Chloroplasts and a cellulose cell wall are plant-specific; both cell types have mitochondria and ribosomes.

questions.text: Ribosomes are enclosed in a membrane.
questions.subject: Biology
questions.explanation: Ribosomes are non-membrane-bound complexes of RNA and protein.
